title: Genetic Lifehacks SNP Coverage Dataset: Which consumer DNA tests include each SNP
description:
Presence-only data on which SNPs (rsIDs and 23andMe i IDs) appear in real raw-data files from nine consumer DNA test versions: 23andMe v3, v4 and v5; AncestryDNA v2 (2020 download); AncestryDNA (March 2026 chip); MyHeritage (2026); tellmeGen; FamilyTreeDNA; and StrateGene (testing era, 2022). It also gives per-test coverage of the 2,171 variants discussed in 413 Genetic Lifehacks articles.

Evidence rules: an ID is 'seen' if it is in at least one file; 'not in files' only when it is absent from all of at least two files; absence from a single file is 'unknown'. An individual's file may still lack a covered SNP because of no-calls or chip revisions.

No genotypes, alleles, positions or per-person data are included. Company names are used for identification only; Genetic Lifehacks is not affiliated with any of these companies. Searchable online with the SNP Coverage Checker: https://www.geneticlifehacks.com/snp-coverage/.
